texts.value: Guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins) are involved as modulators or transducers in various transmembrane signaling systems
G proteins are composed of 3 units; alpha, beta and gamma. The alpha chain contains the guanine nucleotide binding site. Interacts with ADGRB2 (PubMed:28891236)
Belongs to the G-alpha family. G(i/o/t/z) subfamily
